title: Keep mixed-window marker ordering discriminating after history load and remount
outcome: The panel regression continues to detect mixed local/global marker ordering errors at the removal, history and remount boundaries.
acceptance: The marker panel regression includes an older off-window marker alongside a resident marker after older-history transitions and after remounting a bounded tail window.
The strengthened assertions fail with zero-based resident positions compared to global hints and pass with the existing session-offset repair, without weakening navigation assertions.
